name: Are 3D renderings worth paying for before a whole-house remodel?

mainEntity.name: Are 3D renderings worth paying for before a whole-house remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 3D design can help you understand proportions, circulation, cabinetry, finishes, and sightlines before construction, but it is a visualization tool rather than a guarantee of every final color or field condition. Use it to test room relationships and compare options while confirming dimensions, specifications, and construction documents separately. Elite Remodeling & Design identifies 3D visualization as part of planning when appropriate. Ask which elements are to scale, what remains provisional, and how revisions affect cost or schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: They can be valuable when walls move or several rooms must coordinate because they help test proportions, circulation, cabinetry, and finishes before construction. Confirm dimensions and specifications separately, and ask how many revisions are included and whether design changes affect the estimate or schedule.
